definitions.gloss: to be connected, to be linked, to be tied together
definitions.explanation: For two or more things to be joined or associated with each other, either physically or conceptually. Often implies a meaningful or significant connection.

examples.japanese: ⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{結|むす}びついた。

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{歴史的|れきしてき}→歴史的：05671_rekishiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{海上|かいじょう}→海上：09799_kaijou⟧⟦{貿易|ぼうえき}→貿易：01727_boueki⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{結|むす}びついて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: This region is historically connected to maritime trade.

examples.japanese: ⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成果|せいか}→成果：06745_seika⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{結|むす}びつくこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{期待|きたい}→期待：00238_kitai⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It is hoped that the research results will lead to the development of new products.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
Godan verb ({結|むす}びつく → {結|むす}びつきます). Intransitive. The pattern is A⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧B⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{結|むす}びつく (A connects to / leads to B) or A⟦と→と：00512_to⟧B⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{結|むす}びつく (A and B are connected).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{成果|せいか}→成果：06745_seika⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{結|むす}びつく: to lead to results
- ⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{結|むす}びつく: to lead to success
- ⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{結|むす}びつく: to be linked to profit
- ⟦{密接|みっせつ}→密接：12289_missetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{結|むす}びつく: to be closely connected

SIMILAR WORDS:
The transitive counterpart is {結|むす}びつける (to tie together, to connect). ⟦{繋|つな}がる→繋がる：01963_tsunagaru⟧ is a more general word for being connected, while {結|むす}びつく emphasizes a meaningful or significant bond.
